xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The opening and closing balances in respect of overseas related party transactions (as reflected in this utility) have been converted into INR using the closing conversion rate on September 30, 2025 and March 31, 2026 respectively. Further, the amounts of related party transactions during the half year ended March 31, 2026 have been converted into INR using the average of monthly closing exchange rate of October to March 2026.

2. Airtel Payments Bank Limited (‘APBL’) is a subsidiary company as per the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. However, under the applicable Indian Accounting Standards (‘Ind AS’), it is classified as an associate company. The relationship with APBL in the above statement is taken as per Ind AS i.e., associate company.

3. To ensure completeness in reporting,the figures have been rounded up to Two decimels.
